careerResult.signalAlso: {dimension} bhi aapke profile ka ek signal hai.
careerResult.directionSummary: Aapka strongest career alignment {career} ke saath hai; aap related paths bhi explore kar sakte hain.
careerResult.calculationBody: Har answer 1 to 5 hota hai aur (answer - 1) / 4 se normalize hota hai. Normalized answers ko 8 dimensions ke andar average kiya jata hai. 8-dimensional learner vector ko mean absolute difference (L1 distance) se 11 fixed career reference vectors ke saath compare kiya jata hai. Similarity 1 minus mean absolute difference hoti hai; fit percentage similarity times 100 hai. Yeh deterministic mathematical similarity algorithm highest-aligned career profiles identify karta hai.

prompt_engineering.title: Prompt Engineering aur LLM workflows
prompt_engineering.description: Useful aur verify kiye ja sakne wale results ke liye prompts aur multi-step LLM workflows design, test aur improve karein.

ai_automation_n8n.title: AI automation ke liye n8n
ai_automation_n8n.description: Maintainable n8n workflows banayein jo events, APIs, AI models aur human decisions ko connect karein.

vibe_coding.title: Vibe coding: AI se apps banao aur launch karo
vibe_coding.description: AI coding assistants se prototype aur apps ship karein, aur specs, inspection, testing aur security checks se control apne paas rakhein.

generative_ai_llm.title: Generative AI aur LLM app development
generative_ai_llm.description: Model APIs, structured outputs, embeddings, conversation state aur practical reliability controls ke saath LLM applications banayein.

rag_knowledge_systems.title: RAG aur knowledge systems
rag_knowledge_systems.description: Documents ingest aur chunk karein, retrieval aur citations ke saath grounded knowledge assistants banayein aur evaluate karein.

ai_agents.title: AI agents aur tools ka use
ai_agents.description: Bounded agent loops design karein jo tools use karein, state manage karein aur errors se safely recover karein.

mcp_tool_connected_ai.title: MCP aur tools se connected AI
mcp_tool_connected_ai.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP), server-provided tools/resources aur clear permissions se AI apps ko external capabilities se connect karein.

ai_software_engineering.title: AI-powered software engineering
ai_software_engineering.description: Engineering controls ke saath requirements, architecture, coding, testing, review, documentation aur release mein AI apply karein.

ai_evaluation.title: AI Evaluation aur Reliability
ai_evaluation.description: Representative cases, groundedness checks, regression suites, safety controls aur operational monitoring se AI behavior evaluate karein.

ai_builder_capstone.title: AI Builder Capstone project
ai_builder_capstone.description: Real user problem par based AI application plan, build, evaluate, secure, deploy aur present karein.
